Jwt._Key_comment: Jwt:Key is intentionally absent here. Supply it per environment via user-secrets (dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "<32+ chars>") or the Jwt__Key environment variable. Startup fails fast if it is missing.
Jwt._AdminUser_comment: Set Identity:AdminUser:UserName / :Email / :Password the same way to have an administrator seeded on first run.
